```{css}
/* ---- Page styling (optional to change) ----------------------------------
   Change the three colors below to restyle every box at once.
   Colors are hex codes. These match our course colors. */
:root {
  --box-1: #3070BF;   /* blue  */
  --box-2: #367B79;   /* green */
  --box-3: #BF396F;   /* pink  */
}

/* Boxes like the lesson notes: a colored outline with a colored title bar.
   Use them with ::: blue-box, ::: green-box, or ::: pink-box */
.blue-box  { --box: var(--box-1); }
.green-box { --box: var(--box-2); }
.pink-box  { --box: var(--box-3); }
.blue-box, .green-box, .pink-box {
  border: 3px solid var(--box);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0 16px 8px 16px;
  margin: 1.5em 0;
}
.blue-box > h3, .green-box > h3, .pink-box > h3 {
  background-color: var(--box);
  color: white;
  margin: 0 -16px 12px -16px;
  padding: 0.4em 0.75em;
  border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0;
  border-bottom: none;
}
.blue-box strong, .green-box strong, .pink-box strong { color: var(--box); }

/* Smaller, gray text for the data source and AI statement */
.fine-print { font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d; }
```
